pvp_sustained.label: PvP Sustained
pvp_sustained.description: Longer competitive fights after the opening exchange.

low_investment.label: Low Investment
low_investment.description: Base-kit value without optimized premium subsystems.

max_investment.label: Max Investment
max_investment.description: Ceiling with compatible optimized Soul, Martial Spirit and Mount.

offense.label: Offensive pressure
offense.description: Damage coefficients, target breadth, hit count, true/piercing damage and offensive amplification.

tempo.label: Tempo / action economy
tempo.description: Extra casts/actions, pre-turn triggers, resource acceleration and repeat activation.

survivability.label: Survivability
survivability.description: Healing, shields, reduction, immunity, death prevention, revive, HP and defense.

control.label: Control
control.description: Hard/soft control, duration, breadth and repeat application.

support.label: Support
support.description: Team buffs, healing, shielding, cleanse, resource support and ally targeting.

disruption.label: Disruption / counterplay
disruption.description: Dispel, anti-heal, defense bypass, buff removal, resource denial and immunity bypass.

reliability.label: Reliability
reliability.description: How much of the kit works without fragile conditions, RNG or setup.

independence.label: Independence
independence.description: Self-enabling mechanics, self-sustain and low dependency on specific allies.

synergy_ceiling.label: Synergy ceiling
synergy_ceiling.description: Number and strength of mechanics that compound with compatible allies/subsystems.

counter_resilience.label: Counter resilience
counter_resilience.description: Cleanse, resist, immunity, redundancy, revive and ability to keep functioning under disruption.

notes: Axis scores use stable game-adapter benchmarks, not roster percentiles.
Grades use fixed absolute thresholds; no tier has a roster quota.
Source/community tier lists are retained only as reference data and never feed evaluation.
